---
title: 'Cell Biology'
title-block-banner: false
---

A first-cycle course (**3MB001**, 15 ECTS, Umeå University) in modern molecular
cell biology. We follow molecules, signals and decisions through the cell: how
membranes and organelles work, how proteins reach their place, how cells
communicate, move, divide and die, and what happens when these processes go
wrong. Every lecture ends with a drug or a disease that depends on it.

## Where to start

- [**Course plan**](courseplan.md): the official syllabus, outcomes and examination.
- [**Learning outcomes**](elo.md): what each outcome means and where it is taught.
- [**Glossary**](dictionary.qmd): key terms with short definitions.

## How to use the material

Work through the sidebar from top to bottom. Each lecture has:

- **Lecture slides**: press `f` for full screen and `s` for speaker notes, which
  hold the explanations.
- **Quiz**: a quick self-check.
- **Study questions**: the kind of questions the exam asks, including the harder
  VG-style questions.

You do not need to read the textbook (*Molecular Biology of the Cell*, Alberts et
al., 7th ed.) to follow the course. Each lecture names the chapters if you want
to read more.

**See Canvas for the most up-to-date schedule and instructions.**
